title: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. translated_title: 物理结构作为通用哈密顿量学习的组织原则
translated_abstract: 密度泛函理论（DFT）可以给出材料的电子结构，但其高昂的计算成本限制了大型超胞计算和材料筛选。机器学习哈密顿量可以绕过自洽循环，但通常只针对特定体系；而通用模型则有望覆盖新的化学成分和无序固体。这类模型必须能在化学空间中泛化，同时保持下游性质的物理合理性，并在大型晶胞下维持较低的计算成本。本文提出了UniTB，一个通用的E(3)等变哈密顿量表示框架，它将植根于密度泛函紧束缚理论的物理先验与深度学习相结合。UniTB的网络通过修正一个先验哈密顿量来工作，借助由该先验引导路由的专家混合机制，以及类似于自洽电荷紧束缚方法的电荷平衡头，实现跨化学体系的泛化。一个投影操作限制了相对先验的能带偏移，从而抑制虚假态，并使下游性质……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: UniTB是一个将密度泛函紧束缚物理先验与深度学习相结合的通用E(3)等变哈密顿量框架，通过专家混合路由、电荷平衡头和投影约束，实现跨化学体系的泛化并保证下游性质的物理合理性。
en_tdlr: UniTB is a universal E(3)-equivariant Hamiltonian framework that integrates density-functional tight-binding physical priors with deep learning, using prior-routed mixture of experts, charge equilibration, and projection constraints to generalize across chemistries while keeping downstream properties physical.
